newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Malayan Credit buys S$128.89 mln property.
newsitem.headline: Malayan Credit buys S$128.89 mln property.

text.p: Property group Malayan Credit Ltd said on Wednesday it has acquired a freehold property for Singapore $128.89 million.
It said in a statement to the Stock Exchange of Singapore its wholly-owned subsidiary Slavia Pte Ltd had acquired the 6,472.4 square-metre plot from Chung Nan Co Pte Ltd.
The property is located at Robertson Quay, an area being developed for residential and commercial use near the north bank of the Singapore River and on the edge of the business district.
Under the river development guide plan, a 10-storey hotel or a commercial cum residential project could be developed on the property, the statement said.
It said the purchase would be financed by internal funds and bank borrowings.
